newsitem.title: USA: Buffets see Q4 below yr-ago, consensus.
newsitem.headline: Buffets see Q4 below yr-ago, consensus.

text.p: Buffets Inc said Friday it expects its fourth quarter results will be substantially below analysts' consensus expectations and fourth quarter 1995 levels.

"Initial operating inefficiencies associated with the HomeTown merger, and a focus on food and service, resulted in significantly higher costs during the fourth quarter," Roe Hatlen, chairman, said in a statement. "However, our emphasis on service maintained guest satisfaction during a critical period. So long as we serve our guests, I know that we can tackle the costs."
